annotations.title: Create a request for quote to suppliers

description: Creates a request for quote from a materials list or bill of materials (the lines of a takeoff, house, plan or calculation, or the reader's own): Markdown to paste, a CSV, the site's link a merchant opens to price it, and a My Project file. It carries no price and sends nothing to anyone.

currency.description: The currency prices are asked in; left out, the market's.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

items.description: A bill line: as a takeoff, house, plan or calculation answer gives it (label or name, quantity, unit, and order where it says what to buy), or the reader's own.

market.description: Optional. A market whose own opening choice some inputs take (a UK reader's code, an IEC motor), and whose currency symbol prints the caller's own money figures.

note.description: A note to the merchants: delivery address area, dates, access.

project.description: The project's name, as the merchants will see it.

name: create_supplier_quote_request

link.description: The site's request link: the merchant opens it, prices it in their own browser and sends a reply link back.

markdown.description: The request, to paste into a message.

schema.description: The open JSON Schema the request file follows, for a supplier's own software.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.

title: Create a request for quote to suppliers
